backupCard.title: Backup folder
backupCard.intro: Hearth writes a snapshot of everything to a folder you choose — on a USB stick, or a folder that Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or similar keeps in sync — after every change, and can load it back on another computer. Nothing is sent by Hearth itself.
backupCard.unsupported: Your browser cannot write to a folder on its own (Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers can). Use Export dump and Import dump above instead.
backupCard.storeUnencrypted: Store unencrypted (plaintext genetic data in the folder)
backupCard.reconnectNotice: The browser needs your permission again to use this folder.
backupCard.needsPassphrase: Enter the passphrase (or tick unencrypted) to resume backups.
backupCard.loaded: Loaded {people} new people and {genomes} genomes from {name} ({exportedAt}).
backupCard.forgetConfirm: Also delete the backup files in the folder? (Cancel keeps them.)
backupCard.forgottenDeletedWithFiles: Folder forgotten; {n} backup files and {files} documents deleted.
backupCard.attachmentsMissing: {n} attached documents are not on this computer yet.
backupCard.introPhone: Hearth writes a snapshot of everything to a folder or file you pick — in iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or on this device — after every change, and can load it back on another device. The provider's own app does the syncing; nothing is sent by Hearth itself.
backupCard.pickHint: A folder in iCloud Drive keeps everything, attached documents included. Where a provider offers no folder, create a backup file there and open that same file on your other devices.
backupCard.singleNote: A single file holds the snapshot only: attached documents are not copied into it and stay on this device.
backupCard.reconnectNoticeNative: Hearth can no longer reach {name}. Pick it again to resume backups.
backupCard.pickHintAndroid: To use Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive, tap Create backup file…, then open the ☰ menu at the top left of the picker and choose the drive. On your other devices, tap Open backup file… and pick the same file. A single file holds the snapshot only; to keep attached documents too, choose a folder on this device.
backupCard.cloudHint: Sign in, and Hearth keeps a backup there after every change: on Google Drive in the folder you choose, on Dropbox in its own app folder.
backupCard.cloudNote: With a passphrase the copy in the cloud is encrypted; stored unencrypted, anyone who can open that folder can read it. Hearth follows the backup already there.
backupCard.introCloud: Hearth keeps a snapshot of everything after every change — in a cloud drive you sign in to, or in a folder or file you pick — and can load it back on another device.
backupCard.otherPlacesHint: Or somewhere else, through the system picker: OneDrive, a USB drive or a folder on this device. A single file holds the snapshot only; a folder also keeps attached documents.
backupCard.passphraseKept: Kept on this device, encrypted by the phone, so backups continue after a restart.
